summary: Phase 2a (voice notes, approvals, exports, admin dashboard) end-to-end testing. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11_phase2a.py with 31 tests across 5 classes (TestVoiceNotes, TestApprovals, TestExports, TestAdminDashboard, TestRegression). Backend: 29/31 PASS, 1 SKIP (Whisper rejecting tiny synthetic webm — expected per spec), 1 FAIL — /api/files/{file_id} returns 404 for voice-note uploads due to a schema mismatch between voice-notes upload (writes path/filename) and the download endpoint (queries storage_path/original_filename/is_deleted:False). Frontend: All testid-driven flows verified — /approvals page renders with list, tabs, dialog, decisions, export buttons; /admin renders for owner (8 stat tiles + 4 tabs, AI Usage chart, Users table with role/status selects, Tasks & Approvals analytics tabs all working). Found and FIXED a critical regression in Chats.jsx: ReferenceError 'load is not defined' at ChatPanel — `onSent={load}` referenced an undefined symbol, breaking ALL chat panel rendering after a chat is opened (full red overlay error). Replaced with inline re-fetch of /chats/{id}/messages. After fix, voice-record-btn, ask-ai-before-posting, and all chat controls render correctly; clicking voice button shows expected mic-permission-denied toast in headless. Sidebar correctly hides nav-admin for non-admin (Raj) and shows nav-approvals for everyone.

critical.issue: Returns 404. Voice-note upload writes db.files documents with keys {path, filename} and no is_deleted field, but the download_file handler queries {is_deleted: False} and reads record['storage_path'] / record['original_filename']. Result: voice-note audio is unreachable via /api/files/{id}, so the player in chat cannot fetch the blob. Fix: align upload_voice_note to write storage_path/original_filename/is_deleted:False (matching other uploads at server.py:1188-1200), OR change download_file to fall back to path/filename when storage_path is absent.

minor.issue: When Whisper receives a malformed/very tiny webm with no audio frames it returns a 500 instead of an empty-text 200. Acceptable per spec ('accept that empty/silent audio returns empty text') — but a cleaner UX would be to catch the OpenAI error and return text='' with status 200.

Allows any admin to demote an 'owner' to 'member' (or to delete the only owner indirectly via status=disabled on another owner). No safeguard for 'must keep at least one owner'. Low risk in demo, worth noting.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: load is not defined — VoiceRecorder's onSent prop referenced `load`, which does not exist in ChatPanel scope. This crashed the entire chat panel with a red overlay the moment any chat was opened, blocking ALL Phase 2a voice-note flows AND existing chat flows. Patched onSent to re-fetch messages inline.
DialogContent missing aria-describedby — Radix a11y warning in console, non-blocking.
Invited-but-not-redeemed users render with an empty Status select (no value shown). Should default to 'active' label or show 'pending' for not-yet-joined invites.

integration_issues.issue: VoiceNoteBubble fetches the audio blob via /api/files/{file_id}, which returns 404 due to the backend schema mismatch above. Users will see broken/non-playable voice notes after upload until the backend bug is fixed.

BACKEND MINOR: Add safeguard in /api/admin/users PATCH to prevent demoting/disabling the last owner.

FRONTEND MINOR: Default invited users' Status select to 'pending' or 'active' rather than empty.

admin_overview() runs _ws_chat_ids(ws_id) THREE times inside an asyncio.gather (lines 2247, 2257, 2261) and also iterates db.files once more for storage_bytes. Trivial fix: compute chat_ids and threads once and reuse.

Voice note file record schema is inconsistent with the rest of the app (path vs storage_path, no is_deleted, no original_filename). This caused the /api/files/{id} 404. There should be a single helper insert_file_record() used by every uploader.
ChatPanel referenced an undefined `load` symbol — indicates rushed integration of VoiceRecorder. A lint pass with no-undef would have caught this pre-merge.

rca of the issue: TWO root causes found. (1) Voice-note 404: /api/voice-notes inserts {id,path,filename,content_type,size,kind:'voice_note',...} into db.files, but /api/files/{id} (the only download endpoint) was written for a different schema {storage_path, original_filename, is_deleted}. The find_one({is_deleted:False}) filter alone is enough to miss every voice-note record. Reproduction: POST /api/voice-notes with any audio, capture file_id, GET /api/files/{file_id} → 404. Mitigation: align write side to the canonical file-record schema used elsewhere at server.py:1188-1200. (2) Chats ReferenceError: line 447 of Chats.jsx referenced a `load` identifier that doesn't exist in ChatPanel's lexical scope (only `loadChats` exists in the parent Chats component). React threw at render the moment a chat was selected, taking down the entire panel. Already patched.
